findings.problem: The hint "it really is true" also fits wirklich, a separate common word, and the prompt "actually" invites the false friend eigentlich, so the hint does not rule either one out.
findings.fix: hint: in fact, as it turns out (not wirklich or eigentlich)

note: realmente-really is close in meaning, but its prompt "really" matches wirklich better, so leaving sameAs null is reasonable.
